Name: Sweetinsanity9's RRRR Wizard Portraits
Author: sweetinsanity9
Description:
[center][size=3]﻿[font=Tahoma]Here's a set of portraits I made in the same style as my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44050]portrait mod[/url]﻿ for the mod [/font][/size][font=Tahoma][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped[/url]﻿ (RRRR). [/size][/font]


Detailed instructions on my process in my other mod's description.


[color=#cc0000][size=5][b][u]To install:[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]
- Download the mod Portraiture from here on nexus and add it to your mods folder

- Navigate to the Portraiture mod folder. Go to the Portraits folder and put my mod's folder there. The file pathway should be Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/sweetinsanity9Portraits - RRRR

- Launch the game. Click on a character with your mouse, once you are talking to them and press "P", whatever options you have for portraits will cycle through as you press it. All you have to do is choose mine.[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#cc0000][size=4][b][u]For the Optional File:[/u][/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=3]- Download the mod Portraiture from here on nexus and add it to your mods folder

- Navigate to the Portraiture mod folder. Go to the Portraits folder and put the images from the optional download's folder into the [b]SAME[/b] folder as the main portrait mod. The file pathway should be Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/sweetinsanity9Portraits - RRRR

- Launch the game. Click on a character with your mouse, once you are talking to them and press "P", whatever options you have for portraits will cycle through as you press it. All you have to do is choose mine. [/size][/center]
